theme: 美股·中概股名单与市值/市盈率排名及今年以来、近一年阶段收益，话题切换至迪士尼股息率
question: 换成按市盈率从低到高排呢？前三名是哪几家？
answer:
生成查询代码
SELECT 
    ak.COMB_SYMBOL AS `股票代码`, 
    ak.CSNAME AS `股票名称`, 
    ROUND(c.F021N, 2) AS `市盈率`, 
    c.F022D AS `市盈率更新日期`, 
    ROUND((c.F013N / 10.0), 1) AS `市值(亿美元)`, 
    c.F014D AS `市值数据日期`, 
    ak.IS_CHINESE_STOCK AS `是否中概股`
FROM 
    AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN ak
INNER JOIN 
    COM3101 c
    ON ak.FIU_ID = c.FIU_ID
WHERE 
    ak.IS_CHINESE_STOCK = '中概股'
    AND c.F013N IS NOT NULL
    AND c.F014D IS NOT NULL
    AND c.F021N IS NOT NULL
    AND c.F022D IS NOT NULL
    AND c.F021N > 0
ORDER BY 
    c.F021N ASC
LIMIT 3;
